title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 26 July 2026 A slight increase in rainfall is expected in the southwestern part of the island over the next few days, starting from July 28. For Tomorrow: Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, Northern and North-central provinces and in Hambantota, Trincomalee and Puttalam districts.
